## Usage

### Installation

Not on PyPI yet. Install:

``` bash
git clone https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/basedtab.git
pip install -e .
```

## How to use

### Load data

`read_csv` and `save_csv`

``` python
from basedtab.core import BFrame

bf = BFrame.read_csv(toy_path)
bf.head(2)
```

### Groupby

``` python
from basedpl import add, tally, square
MEAN = add.reduce_first / tally
bf.groupby("City", "Income", mean=MEAN)
```

    "Dallas"⌷
              Income
    mean 45252.23119

    "New York City"⌷

    mean 100756.2092

``` python
RMSE = MEAN.under(square)
bf.groupby("Gender", ["Age", "Income"], mean=MEAN, rmse=RMSE)
```

    "Male"⌷
                 Age      Income
    mean  44.9126253  95670.2472
    rmse 46.37557969 98752.06754
